interface.defaultPrompt: Use skills/zodiac-video-pipeline/SKILL.md. Phase 3 is narrator-performance first: compile a minimal Phase3WriterBrief and DO NOT pass the full narrative plan/QC/assets/runtime context into the writer. Current Conversational default vibe is student_peer unless the user asks otherwise. Keep topic early, let action/dialogue prove the insight, avoid post-scene explanation, and make secondary characters change the situation rather than merely feed information. After drafting, reattach the full narrative plan and run validate-narrative.mjs as post-write QC. Preserve evidence boundaries. Keep asset-library-v3 v3.4 and zodiac-remotion@1.15.0 hash 4d52e6ca766649546482a5cdfbf879f4f19c4d3c41c07c7743cccec1a7100ffa; do not make zodiac-job@3 heavier.
